subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes a corpse does not lie and that everything it knows is written on it, to be read by the observer.
source_quote: There is a particular comfort in a corpse. It does not lie. It does not run a counter-play. Everything it knows is written on it, and all I have to do is read.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks the killer had time and was not in a rush, because the blows were precise and there was no blood spray.
source_quote: The blows had been precise. Too precise, too close together, for a man fighting back. No spray across the room — no blood pressure left to throw it. Janussi had been dead before his chest was opened. Whoever did this had not been in a rush. He had not been trying to kill. He had been desecrating a corpse at his leisure, with nowhere to be.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices clotted blood under the nose and smeared bloodstains on the right sleeve of the tunic, indicating Janussi was writing when killed.
source_quote: Clotted blood under the nose. Smeared bloodstains on the right sleeve of the tunic — the *right* sleeve, the working hand.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realizes the black substance on Janussi’s finger and lip is not ink, because it is darker than the ink in the well.
source_quote: The tip of his left forefinger was blackened. Not blue. Darker than blue. And the same dark smudge sat dead-center on his lower lip. ... No. Not ink. That was the entire point of the long look — not that the finger was stained, but that the stain was *wrong*.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suspects the black substance is poison because of its unusual darkness and the way it was transferred from page to finger to lip.
source_quote: Do we think this black stuff might be poisonous? I thought it the likeliest answer.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz understands that the chip in Janussi’s tooth came from falling face-first, not from the murder itself.
source_quote: He had fallen forward. Face-first. Chipped the tooth on the way down.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the killer rolled Janussi onto his back after death to remove his heart.
source_quote: And then the patient hands arriving after, in no hurry at all, rolling the body and opening the chest to make certain he stayed gone.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suspects the killer took only one sapphire and one parchment because they needed exactly that one thing, not because they were greedy.
source_quote: Somebody is trying to build a sapphire spell... a spell that requires a sapphire. ... Whoever did this came in, took one sapphire, and walked past a king's ransom.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices three circular impacts and holes in the armchair and identifies them as darts of pure force.
source_quote: Three circular impacts, horsehair stuffing scattered, two holes punched clean through the chair back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers that bruising cannot form on a corpse because there is no living tissue to swell.
source_quote: Bruising doesn't form on a corpse; there's no living tissue to swell.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realizes the broken nose happened before death, because the bruising was formed while blood was still moving.
source_quote: The bruising around the broken nose held its color, dark and settled, the way bruising only sits when blood was still moving when it formed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices the impression of a chain on Janussi’s neck and identifies two broken lead links as evidence of a locket or necklace being torn off.
source_quote: The impression of a chain on the back and sides, and beneath it two broken lead links. Something had hung there, and someone had torn it off him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suspects the tobacco pipe was used to mask the smell of poison.
source_quote: tobacco smoke would hide the smell of poison. Of course it would.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes the safe was not forced open because the lock was undamaged, meaning the killer had the combination or no need for it.
source_quote: The safe. A box of metal as wide as a man's reach, sunk into the tower wall, its door standing open. ... Open, but undamaged. No forced entry.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes that the treasure in the safe was untouched, indicating the killer was not motivated by greed.
source_quote: Still inside the safe were four sealed pouches, each with its sapphire — and beside them a figurine of a raven, a potion of supreme healing, another of water breathing, five diamonds each worth a fortune, a heap of platinum and gold, a small treasury left untouched.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks the statue of A'lai Aivenmore was knocked over accidentally by the scholar who discovered the body.
source_quote: The statue had simply fallen, it turned out. The Great Reader A'lai Aivenmore had knocked it over in shock when he found the body at dawn.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum feels a quiet sorrow at the image of a clerk dying mid-sentence in his own library.
source_quote: I noted that and felt something I didn't examine too closely — a clerk dying mid-sentence in his own library. There are worse exits.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mutters that he has the second-worst eye for detail in the room, implying he knows he’s bad at observation.
source_quote: Thorin muttered something about having the second-worst eye for detail in the room.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is afraid the candle on the statue might be magically alive and could cause danger.
source_quote: I don't want it to wake up and attack us... I've had, you know, had bad experiences.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the darts aimed at the chair were not meant for Janussi, since he bore no such marks.
source_quote: those darts never miss their mark, Thorin pointed out, and the man bore no such marks.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders if the black substance on Janussi’s finger is like Dumbledore’s style, suggesting he’s making a pop-culture reference.
source_quote: Like, Dumbledore style? Or, like—

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir suggests Glabbagool might have ingested the black substance and could help identify it.
source_quote: Wouldn't Glabbagool have ingested, like, all sorts of different kinds of materials and poisons and goo in the Underdark?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realizes the bruise on Janussi’s nose must have occurred before death because corpses cannot bruise.
source_quote: Grygum, you've got the healer's eye, right? How does bruising work if he's dead? Like, I would assume you don't really. ... You don't — you don't bruise after you're dead.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that the blue ink on *The Discoveries* was the last thing Janussi wrote, and that it came after ink on *The Golden Ass*.
source_quote: The blue ink on *The Discoveries* had been laid down after the blue ink on another book. *The Golden Ass.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is curious about what Janussi was writing in his final unguarded moment, believing the room reads better when you ask what a man was doing then.
source_quote: I'm curious… trying to understand what he was writing at the time of death. The room reads better when you ask what a man was doing in his last unguarded minute than when you ask who he was.

subject: The missing locket
fact: The locket or necklace taken from Janussi’s neck is unidentified, but its removal suggests personal or symbolic significance.
source_quote: Something had hung there, and someone had torn it off him. A locket, a necklace — gone, snapped at the chain.

subject: The missing sapphire and parchment
fact: The killer took only one sapphire and one parchment, indicating a targeted goal rather than random theft.
source_quote: Somebody is trying to build a sapphire spell, a spell that requires a sapphire.

subject: The darts at the chair
fact: The three darts of pure force fired at the chair have no clear motive, and their purpose remains unexplained.
source_quote: Why would you loose three darts of force at a chair?

subject: The black substance
fact: The black substance is unknown but potent enough that even Glabbagool, an ooze that has eaten the Underdark, cannot identify it.
source_quote: Even his failure carried a verdict: there was *something* about the black, something that mattered. When even a creature that has eaten the Underdark can't place a poison, you've learned the poison is worth being afraid of.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum finds the idea of buying another adventure funnier than Zalthir does.
source_quote: He found this funnier than I did.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes most things are funnier to him than they are to Zalthir.
source_quote: Most things, he does.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed the blue ink on the book captured both obscure spell notes and jokes.
source_quote: The blue ink captures both notes on obscure spells and jokes?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized Janussi had shifted from writing jokes to researching spells, based on ink drying patterns.
source_quote: Jokes first. The ink on those had dried. Then he'd flopped over into the spell research.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recalled the Garden Shadow’s saying about absence, though he wasn't sure if it was the Garden Shadow or Brother Tharusk.
source_quote: The Garden Shadow had a saying about that — or possibly Brother Tharusk did, the tall one who always smelled of incense; I wasn't listening to either of them closely.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood that a room reveals itself most through what is missing.
source_quote: A room tells you most by what it is missing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the black residue on Janussi’s fingers and mouth was definitively not blue ink.
source_quote: What color was, like, on his fingers and mouth, was it black or red? Black. Definitively not the blue ink

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin interpreted the gift tag’s cramped, grumpy handwriting as evidence of a bitter rivalry.
source_quote: It's, like, grumpy?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the gift tag supports his theory that Daral Yashenti gave Janussi a bitter gift.
source_quote: Okay, so that supports my theory. Some sort of rival gave him a gift, but it was sort of like a bitter thing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suspects the missing comedy book may contain a cipher or replacement code.
source_quote: There's something written in the book that wasn't part of the original book — or maybe he's using the book and the notes to do some sort of cipher. Some sort of replacement cipher, and there's, like, some sort of code that the book ends up being the key to.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not respond to Daz’s compliment on his thinking, silently considering both poison and cipher as possibilities.
source_quote: I said nothing to that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed the poison and cipher could both be true, and that the missing book carried both.
source_quote: The poison and the cipher could both be true. The missing book carried both.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir despises the scholarly culture of Candlekeep for its hidden grudges and performative civility.
source_quote: I despise this whole place a little — not Candlekeep, Candlekeep's fine, the books are fine — but the *culture* of it, the scholars who keep grudges the way a dragon keeps gold, sitting on them for years, polishing them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recognized Daral Yashenti’s long-standing grudge as a vector of rage that had fully set.
source_quote: Rage that's had time to set is a vector. It points somewhere.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood that Daral Yashenti had unintentionally become the wall of suspicion.
source_quote: Daral Yashenti had just walked himself into being the wall.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew the locket was missing from Janussi’s neck and that it was significant.
source_quote: The locket was missing. Off Janussi's neck.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized the smoke in the room was not meant to kill, but to hide the smell of poison.
source_quote: You don't fill a room with smoke to kill a man — you fill a room with smoke to keep him from smelling what's already there.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed that Sylvira Savikas was carrying a lantern despite being a tiefling who can see in the dark.
source_quote: She was carrying a lantern. She's a tiefling, and she can see in the dark without any light at all.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed the candlelight that lit Sylvira’s face came from the lantern, not a candle.
source_quote: The candlelight that lit her face had not come from a candle at all.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood that Janussi always wore the locket and never took it off.
source_quote: Janussi carried it always, all the time, never took it off.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wanted to find someone who knew what should be in the room to identify what was missing.
source_quote: One thing we need is somebody who knows what should be here, so they can tell us if anything's missing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum intended to ask the housekeeper, Hollypocket, what was missing or out of place.
source_quote: go find, say, the housekeeper, and ask her, what is missing or out of place.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard Hollypocket describe Daral Yashenti as drunk and pounding on Janussi’s door at half past ten.
source_quote: Daral came back at half past ten, drunk as a skunk, pounding on the door until Janussi let him in

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard Hollypocket say Janussi ran away from Daral faster than she’d ever seen him run.
source_quote: I'd never seen him run away so fast.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard Hollypocket say she saw Sylvira Savikas’s face glowing red in the candlelight around 2 or 3 a.m.
source_quote: I swear I could see that devil woman's — Sylvira Savikas's — face glowing red in the candlelight.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum understood that Sylvira was carrying a lantern she didn’t need because she could see in the dark.
source_quote: She was carrying a lantern. She's a tiefling, and she can see in the dark without any light at all.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed that Hollypocket believed Janussi had incurred Sylvira’s wrath that morning.
source_quote: I was never sure but what the keeper saw in her, but he certainly incurred her wrath that morning.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to drink the herbal tea offered by Hollypocket.
source_quote: Thorin declined — "No thank you, I'm good."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the cat had been in the chamber and believed it might provide an alibi or witness testimony.
source_quote: The animal had been in the chamber; the dead don't volunteer alibis, but a five-year-old housecat with opinions might.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believed he could talk to the cat using the Stonespeaker crystal.
source_quote: I think I can talk to the cat,

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was paying no attention to Hollypocket’s weeping, lost in his own thoughts.
source_quote: Daz, I noticed, was paying the weeping woman no attention whatsoever, off somewhere in his own ledger.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suddenly listened when Zalthir mentioned the lantern and Sylvira’s tiefling nature.
source_quote: Hmm," said Daz, suddenly listening after all.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized the locket and the key to the Hightower Library were connected to the missing book and the deletion of records.
source_quote: So could that be the key to the library that was around there? Did somebody… that might explain why that stuff got deleted off the library, or off that book that no one should have touched.

subject: Janussi’s locket
fact: The locket was always worn by Janussi and never removed, making its absence significant.
source_quote: Janussi carried it always, all the time, never took it off.

subject: The two keys to the Hightower Library
fact: One key was around Janussi’s neck and missing; the other was held by the gate warden, Kalan.
source_quote: Janussi held one of the two keys... the other key is heralded by the gate warden, Kalan.

subject: The rivalry between Janussi and Daral Yashenti
fact: Daral Yashenti and Janussi had been at each other's throats for years, with Daral harboring deep resentment.
source_quote: Those two have been at each other's throats for years.

subject: The missing comedy book
fact: The comedy book was the only thing missing from the room, and its absence was the central clue.
source_quote: And now it was gone, and it was the only thing gone.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum feels relieved that someone else has taken an expense off his account.
source_quote: Well, that saves me money on potions," said Grygum, relieved — someone else had just taken an expense off his account.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie is entirely uninterested in being disturbed.
source_quote: Queenie — five years old, sleet-grey, and entirely uninterested in being disturbed.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie believes good ticklers are the only good reason for disturbing her beauty sleep.
source_quote: Any good ticklers are the only good… and good ticklers are… tickles are only the good reason for disturbing my beauty sleep.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz intends to establish what the other party wants and provide exactly enough of it to keep the conversation his.
source_quote: I have run a few of those. Establish what the other party wants and provide exactly enough of it to keep the conversation yours.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes information is currency, and so is scratching behind the ears.
source_quote: Information is currency. So, evidently, is scratching behind the ears.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz respects the precision with which cats categorize people.
source_quote: There is a precision to how cats categorize people that I find I respect.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices that the phrase 'hypnotic block' is doing work the describer doesn't understand.
source_quote: Something in the phrasing snagged. I have spent my life learning to notice when a description is doing work the describer doesn't understand.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the first rule is to read the witness who doesn't know what they're a witness to.
source_quote: The first rule is to read the witness who doesn't know what they're a witness to.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks the book is a TV.
source_quote: Oh, it's a TV!" said Zalthir

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes a shapeshifter situation is going on.
source_quote: Oh, so we've got, like, a shapeshifter situation going on here," said Thorin.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir connects the candle to the shapeshifter situation.
source_quote: That explains the candle," said Zalthir

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie finds two-leggers unclean because they hardly ever lick themselves.
source_quote: It's clear that you hardly ever lick yourselves at all. I've met cleaner dogs in my time.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie refuses to answer more questions because there have been too few tickles and too many questions.
source_quote: There have been too little Tickles and too many questions.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie believes Janussi carried the locket intimately and never took it off.
source_quote: The locket itself is intimate. He carried it all the time. He never took it off.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie does not know what the locket was.
source_quote: I don't know what it was.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie demands that Daz leave and properly lick himself before returning.
source_quote: You may now leave," she said, "and please give yourself a proper licking before returning to my tower.
